description: This file defines the AlertService interface for managing alerts within the OpenMRS system. It includes method signatures for creating, retrieving, and deleting alerts, as well as notifying superusers.

classes.name: AlertService
classes.description: Java interface for alert management operations in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setAlertDAO
methods.description: Sets the specific database access implementation for alerts.

methods.name: saveAlert
methods.description: Saves an alert object to the database, requires authorization.

methods.name: getAlert
methods.description: Retrieves an alert by its internal identifier.

methods.name: purgeAlert
methods.description: Deletes an alert from the database, requires authorization.

methods.name: getAllActiveAlerts
methods.description: Fetches all non-expired alerts for a user.

methods.name: getAlertsByUser
methods.description: Retrieves non-expired, unread alerts for a specific user.

methods.name: getAlerts
methods.description: Finds alerts for a user with specified read and expired status.

methods.name: getAllAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves all unexpired alerts for all users.

methods.name: getAllAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves all alerts, including expired, based on includeExpired parameter.

methods.name: notifySuperUsers
methods.description: Sends an alert notification to all superusers, requires authorization.
